CustomField.description: Technical trigger field only. Flipped to true by both the Final Approval Action and the Final Rejection Action once the Agreement Request's approval process has truly reached its last step, whichever the outcome - Approval_Status__c itself already reaches its terminal value (Approval Complete or Approval Rejected) one step earlier for approvals and does not change again, so this field exists purely to give the final step a real field change to fire on, letting GridUtility re-run the CustomApproval__c mirror with the process's actual final state (GridUtility reads Approval_Status__c at that point to tell approved from rejected). Currently wired only on the first-grid approval processes; nothing resets it back to false afterward, so it can only make the false-to-true transition once per record - reusing it for a later approval cycle (e.g. an Amendment via the future Custom Approval flow) will require explicitly resetting it to false at that cycle's submission step first.
CustomField.label: TECH Agreement Request Finalized
